task: multi-output classification: 6 independent per-nutrient risk models (low/medium/high), plus an unsupervised anomaly/typicality detector
algorithm: Per-nutrient XGBoost classifiers (6 models), tuned with RandomizedSearchCV on macro-F1 across 8 hyperparameters (max_depth, n_estimators, learning_rate, subsample, colsample_bytree, min_child_weight, reg_alpha, reg_lambda) using a leakage-safe StratifiedGroupKFold search. Calibration is verified per nutrient (Brier score + Expected Calibration Error), with isotonic recalibration applied automatically to any nutrient exceeding an ECE of 0.08. An unsupervised IsolationForest (n_estimators=300, contamination=0.05) provides an independent input-typicality signal; it is trained on inputs only and uses no risk labels.
data_disclaimer: Trained on data/module2_farmer.csv, a synthetic, rule-derived dataset. Reported metrics measure how well the models recover the encoded agronomic rules; they are not a claim about field accuracy on real farms. Dataset construction is documented in full in docs/MODEL_DOCUMENTATION.md (Training data): the 7 horticultural crops were added by resampling existing feature+label rows, weighted so that each crop co-occurs with agronomically appropriate soil types, irrigation sources and climate ranges; a zinc/boron risk adjustment is applied for the cucurbit family where documented micronutrient-leaching risk factors are present (sandy/sandy_loam soil or insufficient irrigation); and a zinc adjustment is applied on saline-affected soil across all crops, consistent with the alkaline nutrient-lockout behaviour already specified in Module 2B. These adjustments encode published agronomic relationships rather than measured local field data, and are recorded here so the dataset lineage is fully traceable.

validation_summary.split: StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by input signature (split_group_columns in the schema): no identical input combination appears in both train and test
validation_summary.reliability: per-nutrient cross-validated macro-F1 mean/std reported alongside held-out test scores
validation_summary.calibration: Brier score + ECE per nutrient; all six within threshold, no recalibration required
validation_summary.behavioural_testing: 12-check property-based suite verifying directional agronomic invariants; 12/12 pass
validation_summary.baseline_comparison: RandomForestClassifier(300 trees, max_depth=10) per the project's reference baseline
